title: Grounded XID 79 diagnosis
provenance: hand-authored for tests/demo; NOT recorded from the Anthropic API. Re-record with: python -m ai_diagnosis ... --backend anthropic --record

response.hypothesis: GPU 6 on node-05 fell off the PCIe bus (XID 79), which crashed the collective and hung the job.

claims.text: The kernel logged XID 79 'GPU has fallen off the bus' for node-05.
NCCL reported 'unspecified launch failure' one second later, consistent with the job losing a rank.
Before the event GPU 6 showed no thermal throttling and no ECC errors.
Peer GPUs dropped to a median SM clock of 347.2 MHz, i.e. idle, after the failure.

response.next_action: Drain node-05, collect nvidia-bug-report.sh, then power-cycle (not just reboot) the node; if XID 79 recurs on GPU 6, reseat or RMA the GPU/riser.
